start saves/ladder6_postgame.sav

fastbattles off
pinrng                     # same personalities, genders and natures on every ROM

ev .set ROM_SIZE, 0; createmon 0, 0, SPECIES_JANGMO_O, 100; createmon 0, 1, SPECIES_ORANGURU, 100; createmon 0, 2, SPECIES_PALOSSAND, 100; createmon 0, 3, SPECIES_TURTONATOR, 100; createmon 0, 4, SPECIES_TOGEDEMARU, 100; createmon 0, 5, SPECIES_HAKAMO_O, 100; special CalculatePlayerPartyCount; end
include _sn_party_open.txt
snap L051_party
include _sn_party_to_summary.txt
snap L051_s0_info
sumkey DOWN
snap L051_s1_info
sumkey DOWN
snap L051_s2_info
sumkey DOWN
snap L051_s3_info
sumkey DOWN
snap L051_s4_info
sumkey DOWN
snap L051_s5_info
include ../../scripts/r2_summary_info_page_variants/_sum_close.txt
evstart .set ROM_SIZE, 0; setwildbattle SPECIES_TURTONATOR, 5; createmon 1, 0, SPECIES_TURTONATOR, 5; dowildbattle; end
waitbattle
bwalk L051_bt input:HandleInputChooseAction
snap L051_bt_action
baction RUN
bwalk L051_run free
